title: 밥 먹다가 전화 받았어요: 하던 일 멈추기
objective: By the end, you can attach -다가 to a verb to say that you stopped one action before finishing it and did another, keeping the tense only at the end of the sentence.
summary: Learn to use -다가 to say you stopped doing something partway through and switched to something else.

task.title: Stop and switch actions
task.line: Use the -다가 rules above to fill in, choose, correct, combine, or answer in Korean.

forms.when: Add -다가 to any verb stem. It works the same with or without a final consonant (보다가, 먹다가).
forms.means: I was doing A, stopped before it was finished, and did B.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was eating, then stopped and answered the phone.

forms.when: In everyday speech, people often drop 가.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was reading a book and fell asleep partway through.

forms.when: With 가다, 오다, and similar verbs, when you change your plan partway.
forms.means: I was on my way to A, then changed direction.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was on my way to work, then came back home.

forms.when: When -다가 means stopping partway, the tense goes only on the last verb; don't add 았/었 before -다가.
forms.means: I'll stop doing A for now and do B.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'll stop cleaning and take a short break.

watchOut: 먹었다가 전화를 받았어요 (X) → 먹다가 전화를 받았어요 (O): To say you stopped in the middle, don't add 았/었 before -다가. Put the past tense only at the end.
제가 요리하다가 친구가 왔어요 (X) → 제가 요리하다가 친구 전화를 받았어요 (O): The same person does both actions.
밥을 다 먹다가 나갔어요 (X) → 밥을 다 먹고 나갔어요 (O): -다가 means A was not finished. If you finished A, use -고.
exercises: Change the verb in ( ) using -다가: ① 라면을 (끓이다) ____ 전화를 받았어요. ② 길을 (걷다) ____ 잠깐 쉬었어요.
Was the first action finished? Answer Yes or No: ① 빨래를 하다가 나갔어요. ② 빨래를 하고 나갔어요.
Find the mistake and correct it: 어제 저는 노래를 불렀다가 목이 아파서 멈췄어요.
Join the two sentences into one with -다가: 저는 설거지를 했어요. 그런데 중간에 멈추고 문을 열었어요.
Answer in Korean using -다가 and the words given (보다 / 재미없다 / 끄다): 가: 그 드라마 끝까지 봤어요? 나: 아니요, ____.
answers: ① 끓이다가 (short form: 끓이다) ② 걷다가 (short form: 걷다)
불렀다가 → 부르다가: 어제 저는 노래를 부르다가 목이 아파서 멈췄어요.
